integrity.note: The original MPC-signed bytes remain unchanged and verify. Integrity of a signed historical statement does not make every statement inside it true.

known_claim_defects.note: Only /interop/financial-measure-run-v2.json carries an Ed25519 signature. The other seven run artifacts carry content identifiers but no run signature.

Some historical notes describe excluded or uncarded leaders as separated or tied while the current public fields correctly say separation=UNTESTED. GET /api/gspc now scopes those notes as historical records that do not assert current public fields.

replacement.note: Do not change this status to CURRENT until the replacement snapshot is produced by the live-board snapshot script, signed through the documented three-party MPC custody, and verified offline.
